cipher.summary: Upgraded `zod` from v3 to v4, fixed the resulting `z.record()` single-argument removal across four seam contracts, and fixed `SpecValidationSeam`'s issue-code/path-type handling for the v4 `invalid_format` rename and `PropertyKey[]` path typing; full local gate (`check`, `lint`, `test` 519 passed, `build`, `verify`) is green with zero contract behavior change.
cipher.risks: This upgrade was verified against the existing fixture-backed contract test suite, not a live re-probe of any external provider; if a future zod point release changes another issue-code discriminator not exercised by current fixtures, it would need its own fault-fixture coverage to catch.
